description: Use SendFox from the terminal or an agent to manage audiences and campaigns, sync account data locally, and generate evidence-backed growth, health, performance, and migration reports.
catalog_description: Agent-ready SendFox CLI and MCP server for contacts, lists, campaigns, automations, and forms, with local sync, growth and audience-health reporting, migration analysis, and guarded writes.

novel_features.name: Audience health
novel_features.description: Find duplicate, invalid, suppressed and unassigned contacts, plus engagement recency cohorts with never-versus-unknown evidence.

novel_features.name: Campaign preflight
novel_features.description: Check draft content, targeting, suppression evidence and sender readiness before any send.

novel_features.name: Campaign review
novel_features.description: Combine campaign metrics, recipient-weighted benchmarks, trends, link performance and engagement cohorts into an auditable resend plan.

novel_features.name: Contact dossier
novel_features.description: Join contact details, memberships, tags and available engagement into one support packet.

novel_features.name: Automation plan
novel_features.description: Validate a versioned automation definition and produce inactive creation steps.

novel_features.name: Export bundle
novel_features.description: Produce a read-only local inventory bundle with per-resource completeness, provenance and deterministic hashes.

novel_features.name: Growth report
novel_features.description: Calculate timestamped audience growth from one snapshot and exact observed list joins, leaves, retention and net growth from two.

novel_features.name: Migration readiness
novel_features.description: Compare local platform snapshots with suppression, mapping, delta and cutover gates.
